layout_sources: https://github.com/mvaerle/beancount-rabobank (test_files: the CSV_A_<IBAN>_EUR_<from>_<to>.csv file has CRLF line ends; amounts "+442,98"/"-30,00", "Saldo na trn" "+3436,04"; the importer opens it as latin-1)
https://github.com/firefly-iii/firefly-iii/issues/1420 (Rabobank new-format CSV reported as ANSI, not UTF-8)
notes: Rabo Bankieren "Transacties downloaden" CSV: comma-separated, every field double-quoted (empty ones as ""), ISO-8859-1 (the header word "initiërende" and a café name carry 0xE9/0xEB bytes), CRLF, dates YYYY-MM-DD, amounts always signed ("+2450,00", "-1095,00") with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, "Saldo na trn" the balance after each line, oldest first (Volgnr ascending). Opening worked back from the first line; closing the last line's balance.
